    Product Description

    Introducing the Bulfyss Reversible Double Layer Raincoat -

    The perfect companion for those rainy days!

    This raincoat is made from double layers that are both waterproof and breathable, ensuring that you stay dry and comfortable no matter how hard it rains. The double-layer design provides an extra layer of protection, ensuring that even the heaviest rain won't penetrate through to your clothes underneath.

    HIGH ON STYLE AND VERY FUNCTIONAL

    Premium Material

    The double-layer design and material provides an extra layer of protection, ensuring that even the heaviest rain won't penetrate through to your clothes underneath.

    Adjustable Hood

    The coat is designed to be lightweight and easy to pack, making it perfect for travel and outdoor activities.

    Bulfyss Reversible Double Layer Raincoat is also highly durable, so you can be sure it will last you for many rainy seasons to come

    Wear Both Ways

    The best features of this raincoat is that it's reversible, so you get two stylish looks from one! You can choose to wear the sleek Blue side or the grey side, depending on your mood and the occasion.

    The seams are sealed to prevent any water from seeping in, and the hood is adjustable to ensure a perfect fit. The coat also features snap closures, so you can easily take it on and off.

    Waterproof Pockets

    It comes with double seal pockets to protect your mobile or any device

    This raincoat is perfect for anyone who loves to stay active even in the rain. It's great for hiking, biking, running, and any other outdoor activity where you might get caught in a downpour, It's also great for everyday use

      3.0 out of 5 stars Poor stitching
      Reviewed in India on 29 June 2022
      Size: 3XLColour: BlueVerified Purchase
      Not a good product. Outer layer stitching is very poor. Weared only three times and it's stitchings damaged. Pants are short and not proportional to size. I bought XXXL size it's pant is correct size for me and my height is 5.5 . If you are tall it would be a problem. I bought XXXL size because I used to carry backpack and it's size is ok for me.Another problem I found is that the water gets stored for sometime at the bottom elastic part of the pant in heavy rain and sucked inside. The same problem can happen at your wrist elastic and there is a chance that your watch can get damaged. Better go with non elastic end type rain coats. It's not water proof and it takes time to dry especially the elastic end parts.
